# Will this manifest survive your next Kubernetes upgrade?

> Paste Kubernetes manifests and find every apiVersion and kind a Kubernetes release has removed, before an upgrade rejects them. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
